presentation: One white map, two model buttons, one 16-bin time slider; no video, table, sidebar or visible statistics
coordinates: Original fixed temporal UMAP. No refitting, coordinate motion or cross-model alignment
drawn_inventory: Only features with finite original UMAP coordinates; ordinal zero-profile strips are omitted
measurement: Combined conditional mean, weighted by original per-dictionary MASK/Revealed exposures, divided by original combined 16-bin peak
time: UI1/16–16/16 corresponds exactly to original bins0–15; the final bin includes terminal state

camera.rule: Static per-model coordinate median center. Fit the original three major core boundary extents with42pxdesktop/22pxphone margins; peripheral points can be clipped by the viewport

display_only_changes.outlines: Original core contours for three major categories
display_only_changes.tooltip: Original candidate title or first sentence of reviewed explanation, shortened to170characters

finite_mean_rate_patterns: Verified identical in the original arrays; only means are fetched because the UI has no activation-rate metric
